title: Update Agent Hook Logging Path
description: Change the logHook function to write logs to .semio-repo/📜/🪝/🤖/{{session-id}}/{{timestamp}}_{{semio-repo-agent-hook-event-kind}}.json instead of the current flat .semio-repo/📜/YYMMDDHHMMSS_client_hook-kind.json. Update tests accordingly.
summary: Aligned ticket sessions to stable hook session IDs by removing synthetic open/reopen sessions, ignoring request-scoped IDs, and preventing synthetic fallback sessions in hook tracking. Added regression tests for session inflation.

prompts.prompt: Fix ticket sessions to align with hook session IDs and stop duplicate session accumulation
